description: Search IMI Daily's database of 300+ residence-by-investment, citizenship-by-investment, golden visa, digital nomad, retirement/independent-means, talent and descent programs worldwide. Filter by country, region, type, budget, income, stay requirement and time to citizenship. Returns compact rows with a url to each IMI Daily program page.

citizenship_path.description: Only programs that can lead to citizenship

max_annual_income_usd.description: Applicant's annual income in USD (returns programs whose income requirement is at or below this)

max_annual_stay_days.description: Maximum days per year the person can spend in the country

program_type.description: e.g. 'Citizenship by Investment', 'Residence by Investment' (golden visa), 'Digital Nomad Visa', 'Independent Means Visa', 'Active Investor Visa', 'Talent Visa', 'Citizenship by Descent'

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'EU golden visa real estate'
